facts.text: Girls, the car lot paid for tonight. Smile for the cameras, eat after the second show, and nobody signs a thing without me.
facts.why: Curtis never says this. At the talent show his real line is the bet against the Dreamettes on the Wikiquote page.
facts.fix: $500 says the Dreamettes do not win.

fix_note.text: $500 says the Dreamettes do not win.

facts.why: The 1962 talent show is at the Detroit Theatre. Curtis only starts Rainbow Records afterwards, out of his Cadillac dealership.

facts.text: The Dreamettes' matching wigs at talent night
facts.why: Backstage at the talent show the girls say they have the same wig and the same dress, and turn the wigs around to get a look.
facts.fix: The MC announcing the Creamettes at talent night

facts.text: Gold sequinned gowns under the spotlight
facts.why: No source describes gold sequinned gowns. The Las Vegas debut is shown, but the gown colour is never given.
facts.fix: The Dreams under the spotlight in Las Vegas

facts.text: the new label's Sunday dinner the week the first record takes off
facts.why: The first single, Cadillac Car, flops when a white group covers it. The label only takes off after Curtis turns to payola for the follow-up.
facts.fix: the new label's Sunday dinner the week the second record takes off

facts.text: Lorrell, the youngest of the three, cracking jokes on the tour bus between shows
facts.why: Nothing shows Lorrell as the youngest or any tour bus jokes. The film shows Lorrell in love with Jimmy Early.
facts.fix: Lorrell, the Dreamette in love with Jimmy Early

vibe.verdict: A moody club card with the right name and soul food, but it skips Effie's big moment and Jimmy's rib song.
missing: Effie's 'And I Am Telling You I'm Not Going' showdown (Effie White)

The MC calling them the Creamettes at the talent show (MC and Deena)
Cadillac Car and the cover by Dave and the Sweethearts (first single)
